show_screen.name: Show screen
show_screen.description: Show one screen now, for a number of seconds or until the rotation is resumed.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: Name of the screen in screens.yaml, or 'clock'.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to show it. Leave empty to keep it until another screen is chosen.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: Name of the clock (as in the app's clocks option). Leave empty for every clock.

flash_message.name: Flash message
flash_message.description: Show a short message across the six tubes, then go back to what was showing.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to show. Templates are not rendered; render them in the automation.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Optional icon shown on the first tube.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: Name of the clock (as in the app's clocks option). Leave empty for every clock.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Hand the tubes back to the clock's own time display and stop sending screens.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Resume by itself after this long. Leave empty to pause until resumed.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: Name of the clock (as in the app's clocks option). Leave empty for every clock.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: End a pause, a pinned screen or a message and go back to the rotation.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: Name of the clock (as in the app's clocks option). Leave empty for every clock.

next_screen.name: Next screen
next_screen.description: Move on to the next screen of the rotation, like the clock's button.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: Name of the clock (as in the app's clocks option). Leave empty for every clock.

set_rotation.name: Set rotation
set_rotation.description: Turn cycling through the screens on or off. Off means the clock's button changes screens.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: Name of the clock (as in the app's clocks option). Leave empty for every clock.

gif_needs_2_4.title: Clock {clock} cannot play GIFs
gif_needs_2_4.description: A screen uses a gif tube, but this clock's firmware cannot play GIFs, so only the first frame is shown. Update the clock to HA Tubes 2.4 or newer (Settings > Devices > the clock's Firmware update).

transitions_need_2_5.title: Clock {clock} cannot play transitions itself
transitions_need_2_5.description: A screen uses a transition, but this clock's firmware cannot play transitions itself, so the app plays a simpler one instead. Update the clock to HA Tubes 2.5 or newer (Settings > Devices > the clock's Firmware update).
